name: Life rafts, retrieval nets, sea rescue baskets
description: Inflatable liferafts (float-free and davit-launched), their canisters and hydrostatic release units, plus personnel transfer baskets / rescue baskets. Retrieval nets were not directly evidenced in the pages read; this is recorded as a gap.
aliases: Life rafts, retrieval nets, sea rescue baskets

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Mass limit for side-to-side transfer
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 133.150(c)(1): craft boarded from deck less than 4.5 m above waterline and mass not more than 185 kg need not have launching appliance; LSA Code 4.1.2.2 equivalent

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Inflation time at 18-20 C
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.2.3: inflation completed within 1 min at ambient 18-20 C

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Inflation time at -30 C
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.2.3: inflation completed within 3 min at -30 C

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Buoyancy chamber compartment withstand pressure
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.2.4 (numbered 4.2.7.4 in OCR mirror): each inflatable compartment withstand at least 3 times working pressure

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Carrying capacity divisor - tube volume
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.3.1: greatest whole number from volume of main buoyancy tubes divided by 0.096

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Carrying capacity divisor - floor area
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.3.2: inner horizontal cross-sectional area divided by 0.372

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Boarding ramp load
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.4.1: at least one entrance with semi-rigid boarding ramp capable of supporting a person weighing 100 kg sitting or kneeling and not holding onto the raft

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Boarding ladder lowest step below waterline
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.4.2 for entrances without a boarding ramp

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Towing speed with full complement
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.5.3

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Water pockets fill time
specifications.unit: % of capacity within 25 s of deployment
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.5.4.2 in OCR mirror

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Water pocket aggregate capacity, up to 10 persons
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.5.4.3 in OCR mirror

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Davit-launched raft suspension load
specifications.unit: times mass of full complement of persons and equipment
specifications.basis: LSA Code 4.2.8.1.1: at 20 +/- 3 C with all relief valves inoperative

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Service interval (MODU)
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(g)(1): each inflatable lifesaving appliance serviced within 12 months of initial packing and each subsequent servicing (5-month delay allowed to next scheduled inspection)

specifications.metric: Inflatable liferaft (SOLAS / USCG-SOLAS  — Aggregate capacity, manned offshore installation
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(1)(b): one or more inflatable liferafts with combined capacity at least 100% of total POB, float-free capability, Class A equipment

specifications.metric: Hydrostatic release unit (HRU) and float — HRU service interval (MODU)
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(h)(1): each hydrostatic release unit other than disposable serviced within 12 months of manufacture and each subsequent servicing

specifications.metric: Offshore personnel transfer basket / res — Capacity, SAFE-TRANSFER 8-person
specifications.basis: Viking Life product page 1145-8: 'Capacity: 8 persons'

specifications.metric: Offshore personnel transfer basket / res — Payload, SAFE-TRANSFER 8-person
specifications.basis: Viking Life product page: 'Max load (payload): 1000 kg'

specifications.metric: Offshore personnel transfer basket / res — Rescue basket capacity, Canadian offshore rule
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(1)(f)(iii): 'a rescue basket capable of accommodating at least six persons'

specifications.metric: Offshore personnel transfer basket / res — Buoyant personnel transfer baskets, Canadian offshore rule
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(1)(f)(viii)

specifications.metric: Reliability — Inflatable liferaft service interval
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(g)(1) for MODUs
